cases.description: tsigState is TSIG_UNSIGNED (0); isSigned() should return false.
tsigState is TSIG_INTERMEDIATE (2); isSigned() should return false.
tsigState is TSIG_SIGNED (3); isSigned() should return true.
tsigState is TSIG_VERIFIED (1); isSigned() should return true.
tsigState is TSIG_FAILED (4); isSigned() should return true.
tsigState is an unexpected value (e.g., 99); isSigned() should return false.
tsigState is set to a negative value (-1) via reflection; isSigned() should return false because it is not a defined signed state.
tsigState is set to a value just above the defined range (5) via reflection; isSigned() should return false.
tsigState is set to Integer.MAX_VALUE via reflection; isSigned() should return false as the value is not one of the signed constants.
tsigState is set to Integer.MIN_VALUE via reflection; isSigned() should return false because it is not a recognized signed state.
